messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: Customer OrbitEdge (Private VPC) experiencing 502/504s through their NLB -> ALB path. High error rate since 01:20 UTC. Auto-escalation to oncall.
maria.pager: Paging jamal-oncall — seeing spike ~30% error rate across frontends, some tenants unreachable. Traces show NLB target failures, ALB healthy checks flapping.
jamal-oncall: Acked. Joining. I'm spinning up the triage channel, will collect impact and mitigation options.
alice-sre: Jumping in. Can someone paste the NLB health logs and recent config diffs? Suspect security group or route change during the 01:15 deploy window.
ben-netops: Pasting recent VPC flow sample and NLB target health summary:
```
NLB target 10.10.45.12: unhealthy -> TLS handshake timeout
NLB target 10.10.45.13: healthy
ALB target group tg-oe-web: 5xx count increased by 120 in 5m
SG-oe-app inbound 443 allowed from NLB only
```
ben-netops: No recent SG commits in the last 12h in audit logs. There was a config patch on the customer's side to the private gateway at 00:58 UTC.
dan-custeng: OrbitEdge reports they rolled a private gateway kernel config at 00:55 — testing said low risk. They see SYN retries to app instances.
jamal-oncall: Okay hypothesis: private gateway change caused asymmetric routing -> NLB health failures. Immediate mitigation: failover NLB traffic to ALB path (we have ALB in front of some tenants) or shift DNS weight to regional fallback.
alice-sre: Quick test: toggle NLB connection draining to force re-registration and route short-term. Also prepare DNS weighted shift to fallback region. I can run the NLB drain command.
ben-netops: If we force drain, we should ensure instance conntrack is cleared to avoid stuck sockets. Recommend ephemeral host restart on 10.10.45.12 after drain.
jamal-oncall: Running drain now on target 10.10.45.12
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg:... --targets Id=i-0abc12345
```
jamal-oncall: Deregister issued. Health checks are re-evaluating.
dan-custeng: OrbitEdge confirmed they see decreased traffic to 10.10.45.12 and some requests routing to backup pool.
emily-nextoncall: Noted for handoff — will monitor metrics post-drain for 15m.
alice-sre: ALB fallback plan: shift 25% DNS weight to ALB endpoint now, 75% remain on NLB to avoid customer-wide blip. I'll prepare Route53 change.
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.orbitedge.internal.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"alb-fallback","Weight":25,"TTL":20,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"3.12.34.56"}]}}]}' --hosted-zone-id Z123
```
alice-sre: Pushed weighted DNS change. Monitor should show traffic moving.
maria.pager: Customer impact update: 12 tenant routes impacted earlier, now down to 4 tenants with intermittent errors. Customer reports degraded UX but no full outage for paid tier.
jamal-oncall: Observed 5xx count drop by 60% in 6m. NLB target re-registered and passed health checks after conntrack flush on host 10.10.45.12 (ben performed restart).
ben-netops: Confirmed restart done. Conntrack cleared, TCP handshake success. NLB target healthy.
dan-custeng: OrbitEdge says premium customer sessions are stable, free-tier still seeing occasional errors — acceptance criteria met for immediate mitigation.
alice-sre: Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic. Next steps: full postmortem runbook items — verify private gateway config change, request rollback details from OrbitEdge, add preflight checks to our deployment acceptance for kernel changes.
emily-nextoncall: Taking ownership for next 4h quiet period monitoring and postmortem draft. Will follow up with OrbitEdge PM for RCA sync.
jamal-oncall: Handoff: handing to emily-nextoncall at 02:30 UTC. Oncall notes saved in incident tracker #INC-2026-418.
incident-bot: Incident severity lowered to SEV2. Update: mitigation applied, traffic stabilized. Please add post-incident action items to #incidents-postmortem.
maria.pager: Thanks team. I'll notify account exec and open a support ticket with OrbitEdge for formal RCA.
alice-sre: Action items summary (short):
- Confirm OrbitEdge kernel config diff and get rollback details (dan)  
- Add conntrack check + drain to private gateway runbook (ben)  
- Route53 weighted fallback playbook and automation (alice)  
- Postmortem + customer RCA sync (emily)

jamal-oncall: Closing live page. If anything regresses, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
